title: Build tier list
intro_one: Compare {{count}} supported upstream level-60 DPS preset with its complete recorded setup.
intro_other: Compare {{count}} supported upstream level-60 DPS presets with their complete recorded setups.
limitations: These builds mix pre-raid, phase-one and development gear. Their gear levels are unequal. The ranking measures personal single-target DPS, including pets, under these exact setups; it does not establish absolute class balance.
raidSupport: Every build receives full raid, party and individual buffs and target debuffs, including support it cannot supply itself. Utility, survival, movement and the value of providing raid support are outside this comparison.
bestRaceHelp: Each build uses its highest estimated race for this fight. Close race estimates can be indistinguishable at this precision. Inspect a build to see every legal race.
fixedRaceHelp: Only builds with this legal class and race combination appear. Other builds are excluded from the comparison.
searchPlaceholder: Search build, class, gear or rotation
reference_one: Reference: {{name}} ({{race}}), {{dps}} DPS. Showing {{count}} of {{total}} builds. Search leaves this reference unchanged.
reference_other: Reference: {{name}} ({{race}}), {{dps}} DPS. Showing {{count}} of {{total}} builds. Search leaves this reference unchanged.
omitted_one: {{count}} build has no legal {{race}} result for this encounter and is excluded:
omitted_other: {{count}} builds have no legal {{race}} result for this encounter and are excluded:
estimateHelp: DPS ± the approximate marginal 95% Monte Carlo interval (1.96 standard errors). Spread is the gap from a build's lowest to highest race estimate in this fight.
indistinguishable: Indistinguishable from reference at this precision
boundaryHelp: Approximate 95% gap interval: {{low}}% to {{high}}%. It crosses a tier boundary.
noSearch: No builds match your search. Clear it to show the comparison again.
noResults: No recorded builds match this race and encounter. Choose another race or comparison.
methodFight: Fixed-length fights against one level {{level}} target with {{armor}} armor. Each race and encounter has {{iterations}} iterations with seed 101. Each preset keeps its recorded gear, talents, rotation, class and pet options, consumables, weapon swaps and support across races.
methodNoise: Close results use an independent approximation: the difference's standard error is the square root of the sum of squared standard errors. A shared seed alone does not establish a paired comparison. These marginal intervals describe simulation sampling noise; they do not cover uncertain game mechanics or establish simultaneous confidence across all comparisons.
methodSelection: Selecting the highest observed race can bias that estimate upward. The displayed race is an estimate for this encounter, not proof of a unique optimum. Gear and rotations are not optimized separately for each race.
methodTiers: Gaps round to two decimal places before tier assignment. Boundary warnings use an approximate delta-method interval for the DPS ratio to the reference, with independent errors and a fixed selected reference. Search only hides rows; class and race choices change the reference population.
requestHelp: Complete Go RaidSimRequest for {{race}}, {{seconds}} seconds, {{target}}. This file is for the Go runner, not the simulator UI import. Only race, duration and target creature type change from the recorded request.
raceResults: All legal races in this encounter
raceResultsHelp: Races sort by estimated DPS. Estimates within the approximate 95% independent difference interval of the highest race are indistinguishable at this precision.
settings: Recorded class, pet, consumable and support settings
settingsHelp: These are the saved request values. Nested headings follow the recorded settings; omitted fields use the Go message defaults. The download contains every field, including the rotation and database.
